feedback.wrong: That's not it. Look closely and try again.
feedback.order: Right item, wrong order. What comes first?
feedback.found: Good! Tap it again any time to see it up close in 3D 🔍.

drag.tip: Drag each item to its spot, or tap it and then tap the destination.

meter.tip: Set the dial and tap two points in the scene to place the leads.
meter.wrongMode: The dial is not on the right mode for this test.
meter.wrongPoints: The leads are not on the right points.

inspect.findTip: Tap the points that have a problem (marked: {n}), then press Report.
inspect.falsePositive: You marked something that's fine. Look again.
inspect.missed: There's still a problem you haven't found.

results.failRule: Golden rule: if you didn't test it, it's NOT dead. If it's not locked out, it's NOT safe.
results.shareText: I scored {score} {stars} on “{title}” in Electrician Sim US. Can you beat me? 👷⚡

menu.tagline: Real US electrical work — for Spanish speakers
menu.intro: Learn electrician work the way it's done on site: your foreman gives orders in English and Rosa, your instructor, explains everything. Tap highlighted words to see their meaning and hear them.
menu.resetConfirm: Are you sure you want to erase all progress?
menu.disclaimer: Educational simulator. Not a substitute for official training, the NEC or OSHA rules. Always work under a licensed electrician.
